typedef unsigned long long u64;

struct fwd_only {
	u64 id;
};

struct node {
	struct node *next;
	int value;
};

struct fwd_holder {
	struct fwd_only *fwd;
};

struct never_defined;

struct never_holder {
	struct never_defined *ptr;
};

struct empty {};

typedef unsigned int u32;

typedef void (*void_fn)(void);

struct tricky {
	u32 (*array_ptr)[4];
	int (*fp_arr[2])(int);
	void_fn fn;
};

struct bits {
	unsigned int a: 3;
	unsigned int b: 5;
	int c: 1;
	unsigned int d: 7;
};

typedef unsigned char u8;

struct packed_sample {
	u8 a;
	u32 b;
} __attribute__((packed));

struct flex {
	u32 len;
	u8 data[0];
};

typedef int s32;

struct anon_holder {
	struct {
		int x;
		int y;
	} point;
	union {
		u32 u;
		s32 i;
	};
};

typedef int (*callback_t)(int, const char *);

typedef u32 u32_array[3];

struct fn_holder {
	callback_t callback;
	int (*direct)(int, const char *);
	volatile const u32 *cv;
	u32 * const fixed;
	u32 matrix[2][3];
	u32_array triple;
};

union sample_union {
	u32 u;
	s32 i;
	u8 bytes[4];
};

struct tagged {
	int value __attribute__((btf_decl_tag("field_tag")));
	int __attribute__((btf_type_tag("user"))) *ptr;
} __attribute__((btf_decl_tag("struct_tag")));

enum color {
	COLOR_RED = 0,
	COLOR_GREEN = 5,
	COLOR_BLUE = 6,
};

enum signed_color {
	SIGNED_NEG = -2,
	SIGNED_POS = 2,
};

enum big64 {
	BIG64_ONE = 1ULL,
	BIG64_HIGH = 4294967296ULL,
};

enum small8 {
	SMALL8_ONE = 1,
} __attribute__((mode(byte)));
